Name: Metro Caring Fresh Foods Market
What to bring: Appointment recommended. Book on the website or call.
Notes: Free grocery store, open to anyone. Closed the first Thursday of each month. Also closed Nov 5, Nov 26, Dec 3, and Dec 31.

Name: SAME Cafe
Notes: Pay what you can, volunteer your time, or bring produce in exchange for a meal. Closed on federal holidays.

Name: Hunger Free Colorado Food Resource Hotline
Notes: Free phone line for all of Colorado. Help finding food near you and applying for SNAP (food stamps). Over 150 languages. Messages left after hours are returned the next business day.

Name: Denver Human Services: SNAP (food stamps) help
Notes: Staff can help you apply for SNAP by phone, or mail you a paper application. You can also apply online at Colorado PEAK.

Name: Integrated Family Community Services (IFCS) Food Market
Notes: Schedules posted online do not agree. Please call to confirm days and hours.

Name: Community Table (Arvada Community Food Bank)
Notes: May be moving to 4600 W 60th Ave in Arvada. Call before you go.

Name: Denver Rescue Mission Lawrence Street Community Center
Notes: Day center with meals, drinking water, and restrooms for people experiencing homelessness.

Name: IFCS Fresh Thanks (Thanksgiving food boxes)
Notes: EXAMPLE ROW, NOT LIVE. Fill in the address, Event date, and hours once IFCS announces 2026 details, then change Active to Y.
